sources.title: Jev AI Model (TypeSafe) — Typed System One Decisions
sources.snippet: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One model: it returns a choice, score, or yes/no probability instead of chat. The hosted API is open as of 21 September 2026. $0.042 per 1M input tokens, output free.
